title: Submit a pack to a public hub/config registry
context: Listing a pack in a public hub/config registry (UCSC public hub registry or JBrowse config registry) dramatically increases discoverability and enables self-serve adoption by researchers and educators who browse these registries. PLAN.md explicitly states that auto-publishing is a non-goal — a human submits after review. M3 requires at least one pack listed in a public registry as a verifiable adoption signal.
objective: Submit at least one delivered, render-verified pack to the UCSC public hub registry or JBrowse config registry, and document the submission process for future submissions.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one delivered pack (render-verified, provenance complete, not-medical-advice present) is submitted to the UCSC public hub registry or JBrowse config registry by a human submitter (no automated upload).
The submission is accepted (or the rejection reason is recorded with a remediation plan).
The registry listing URL is recorded in the Steward's outcomes/<pack-id>.json as an externally verifiable adoption event.
A process document is committed describing the submission steps for future packs.
Document output licensed CC-BY-4.0; commit is DCO signed-off.
resources: PLAN.md §5 (In-scope — self-serve hosting and registry submission)
output: review/registry-020-submission.md — committed submission record and process document; outcomes/<pack-id>.json updated with registry listing URL.
